review_method: Direct inspection of all three delivered PNGs
observations: Both drift figures contain one HF panel, the prescribed three ranks, fixed consistent colors, one-decimal value labels, random SD error bars and a lower legend. The k=2 group is shaded with no text annotation.
The negative label-free nuisance recovery at k=2 is retained, and k=8/16 are both displayed. No rank or unfavorable result is omitted.

The crop figure contains the same 20 RoIs in the same 2x10 positions. It has no global title; every small label contains only weather and the original signed coordinate rounded to three decimals. Original aspect ratios and bounding boxes are retained.
